scripts.title: Fix Lag
scripts.script:
-- SCRIPT FIX LAG TOÀN NĂNG CHO MỌI GAME ROBLOX (UNIVERSAL NO-GFX CÓ GUI KÉO THẢ)
local CoreGui = game:GetService("CoreGui")
local Workspace = game:GetService("Workspace")
local Lighting = game:GetService("Lighting")
local UserInputService = game:GetService("UserInputService")
local Camera = Workspace.CurrentCamera

-- 1. Tạo Giao Diện Không Bị Reset Khi Chết
local ScreenGui = Instance.new("ScreenGui")
ScreenGui.Name = "Universal_AntiLag_GUI"
ScreenGui.ResetOnSpawn = false

pcall(function() ScreenGui.Parent = CoreGui end)
if not ScreenGui.Parent then
    ScreenGui.Parent = game.Players.LocalPlayer:WaitForChild("PlayerGui")
end

-- Tạo nút bấm Toggle
local ToggleButton = Instance.new("TextButton")
ToggleButton.Name = "ToggleButton"
ToggleButton.Size = UDim2.new(0, 140, 0, 40)
ToggleButton.Position = UDim2.new(0, 10, 0.4, 0)
ToggleButton.BackgroundColor3 = Color3.fromRGB(255, 60, 60) -- Màu đỏ (Đang Tắt)
ToggleButton.Text = "Universal Lag: OFF"
ToggleButton.TextColor3 = Color3.fromRGB(255, 255, 255)
ToggleButton.Font = Enum.Font.SourceSansBold
ToggleButton.TextSize = 14
ToggleButton.BorderSizePixel = 0
ToggleButton.ClipsDescendants = true
ToggleButton.Parent = ScreenGui

local UICorner = Instance.new("UICorner")
UICorner.CornerRadius = UDim.new(0, 8)
UICorner.Parent = ToggleButton

-- 2. Hệ Thống Kéo Thả Di Chuyển (PC & Mobile)
local dragging, dragInput, dragStart, startPos
local function update(input)
    local delta = input.Position - dragStart
    ToggleButton.Position = UDim2.new(startPos.X.Scale, startPos.X.Offset + delta.X, startPos.Y.Scale, startPos.Y.Offset + delta.Y)
end

ToggleButton.InputBegan:Connect(function(input)
    if input.UserInputType == Enum.UserInputType.MouseButton1 or input.UserInputType == Enum.UserInputType.Touch then
        dragging = true
        dragStart = input.Position
        startPos = ToggleButton.Position
        input.Changed:Connect(function()
            if input.UserInputState == Enum.UserInputState.End then dragging = false end
        end)
    end
end)

ToggleButton.InputChanged:Connect(function(input)
    if input.UserInputType == Enum.UserInputType.MouseMovement or input.UserInputType == Enum.UserInputType.Touch then
        dragInput = input
    end
end)

UserInputService.InputChanged:Connect(function(input)
    if input == dragInput and dragging then update(input) end
end)

-- 3. Cơ Chế Giảm Tải Đồ Họa Toàn Năng
local FixLagEnabled = false
local OriginalParts = {}
local OriginalShadows = Lighting.GlobalShadows

-- Định nghĩa các Class hiệu ứng cần xử lý
local EffectClasses = {
    "ParticleEmitter", "Trail", "Beam", "Fire", "Smoke", "Sparkles", "Explosion", 
    "Decal", "Texture", "PostEffect", "Atmosphere", "Sky", "Clouds", "SunRaysEffect"
}

local function applyFixLag(v)
    if not FixLagEnabled then return end
    
    -- Xử lý các loại hạt và hiệu ứng môi trường thông qua ClassName gốc của Roblox
    for _, className in ipairs(EffectClasses) do
        if v:IsA(className) then
            if v:IsA("ParticleEmitter") or v:IsA("Trail") or v:IsA("Beam") or v:IsA("Fire") or v:IsA("Smoke") or v:IsA("Sparkles") then
                v.Enabled = false
            elseif v:IsA("Explosion") or v:IsA("PostEffect") or v:IsA("Atmosphere") or v:IsA("SunRaysEffect") then
                if v:IsA("Explosion") then v.Visible = false else v.Enabled = false end
            elseif v:IsA("Decal") or v:IsA("Texture") then
                v.Transparency = 1
            end
            return
        end
    end
    
    -- Xử lý vật thể thô (Khối xây dựng map, skill đòn đánh dạng Mesh)
    if v:IsA("BasePart") and not v:IsDescendantOf(game.Players.LocalPlayer.Character) then
        if not OriginalParts[v] then
            OriginalParts[v] = {Material = v.Material, CastShadow = v.CastShadow, Transparency = v.Transparency}
        end
        v.Material = Enum.Material.SmoothPlastic
        v.CastShadow = false
        
        -- Nhận diện các khối kỹ năng lớn thường trong suốt hoặc có tên chứa từ khóa đặc biệt để ẩn đi
        local nameLower = v.Name:lower()
        if nameLower:find("effect") or nameLower:find("mesh") or nameLower:find("hit") or v.Transparency > 0.5 then
            v.Transparency = 1
        end
    end
end

-- Hàm khôi phục lại đồ họa ban đầu
local function restoreGraphics()
    Lighting.GlobalShadows = OriginalShadows
    
    -- Bật lại hiệu ứng ánh sáng môi trường
    for _, v in pairs(Lighting:GetChildren()) do
        for _, className in ipairs(EffectClasses) do
            if v:IsA(className) and (v:IsA("PostEffect") or v:IsA("Atmosphere") or v:IsA("SunRaysEffect")) then
                v.Enabled = true
            end
        end
    end
    
    -- Trả lại chất liệu và độ trong suốt cho các khối
    for part, orig in pairs(OriginalParts) do
        if part and part.Parent then
            part.Material = orig.Material
            part.CastShadow = orig.CastShadow
            part.Transparency = orig.Transparency
        end
    end
    
    -- Bật lại hạt và decal trên toàn map
    for _, v in pairs(Workspace:GetDescendants()) do
        if v:IsA("ParticleEmitter") or v:IsA("Trail") or v:IsA("Beam") or v:IsA("Fire") or v:IsA("Smoke") or v:IsA("Sparkles") then
            v.Enabled = true
        elseif v:IsA("Decal") or v:IsA("Texture") then
            v.Transparency = 0
        end
    end
    table.clear(OriginalParts)
end

-- Vòng lặp bắt các hiệu ứng phát sinh thời gian thực (Kỹ năng tung ra)
local function onDescendantAdded(v)
    if FixLagEnabled then
        task.spawn(function()
            task.wait()
            if v and v.Parent then applyFixLag(v) end
        end)
    end
end

Workspace.DescendantAdded:Connect(onDescendantAdded)
Camera.DescendantAdded:Connect(onDescendantAdded)

-- 4. Logic Nút Bấm
ToggleButton.MouseButton1Click:Connect(function()
    FixLagEnabled = not FixLagEnabled
    
    if FixLagEnabled then
        ToggleButton.Text = "Universal Lag: ON"
        ToggleButton.BackgroundColor3 = Color3.fromRGB(60, 220, 60) -- Xanh lá
        Lighting.GlobalShadows = false
        
        -- Quét toàn cục trò chơi
        for _, v in pairs(Workspace:GetDescendants()) do applyFixLag(v) end
        for _, v in pairs(Lighting:GetChildren()) do applyFixLag(v) end
        for _, v in pairs(Camera:GetDescendants()) do applyFixLag(v) end
    else
        ToggleButton.Text = "Universal Lag: OFF"
        ToggleButton.BackgroundColor3 = Color3.fromRGB(255, 60, 60) -- Đỏ
        restoreGraphics()
    end
end)

print("--- ĐÃ KHỞI CHẠY SCRIPT FIX LAG TOÀN NĂNG ROBLOX CHÀO MỪNG BẠN ---")

scripts.features:
Interaction & Input Testing

Camera Tracking Assistant: Smoothing-based viewport tracking to automatically focus the camera on nearby targets, simulating player focus.
Input Simulation: Automated click simulation for testing UI interactions, hitboxes, and event triggers without manual repetition.
Target Indicators: Dynamic Indicators on target parts that turn Red when focused by the camera tracking system.
Position-Force: Instantly move your humanoid in any direction using direction inputs.

Visuals & Analytics

Gh0st Mode: Removes obstructive UI elements to provide a cleaner debugging experience.
Player Visualization: Full humanoidHitbox rendering, playerTags with user info, worldDistance tracking, and playerTeam identification.
Distance-based Sorting: Color-coded proximity: Pink (Closest), Red (≤750 studs), Yellow (≤1875 studs), and Green (>1875 studs).
Health HUD: Numerical health display and real-time health bars on player nametags.
Equipped Item Viewer: View the currently equipped items being held by nearby players.
Closest Player Tracker: Real-time HUD displaying the nearest player's name and worldDistance.
Local Health HUD: Compact display of your current character health and max health.
worldLighting Modifiers: Toggle Fullbright (maximum brightness, no shadows/fog) or FullDark (minimum brightness) to test visibility in extreme lighting conditions.
Any-Item-ESP: Create visual markers for any item, folder, or instance group in your workspace to track spawns and replication.

Developer Utilities

PlayerPage: Comprehensive player management including whitelisting, blacklisting, and detailed property viewing/spectating for testing moderation and replication.
Item Panel: Robust item explorer and property editor for backpack and character tools.
World Humanoid Editor: Edit properties (WalkSpeed, JumpPower, Health, etc.) of any non-local Humanoid or NPC to test AI behavior and limits.
Br3ak3r (Collision Debugger): Isolate map geometry, remove physical obstacles, and disable collisions to analyze map structure and walk through walls.
H1ghL1ghter: Highlight specific parts and instantly retrieve their full workspace paths.
D3v Tool: Real-time HUD displaying World Time, Local Player Coordinates (LPC), and Mouse Coordinates (LMC).
Waypoint System: Create and manage custom 3D map markers visible from anywhere in the scene.
Free-cam: Cinematic, detached camera exploration for map scouting and recording.
Performance Monitor: Real-time FPS, ping, memory usage, and custom object counts (Broken/Highlighted instances).
Humanoid Editor: Directly override your LocalPlayer's humanoid properties (WalkSpeed, JumpPower, MaxSlopeAngle) to test movement edge cases.
Anti-AFK: Built-in mechanism to prevent idle disconnections during long observation sessions.
Scroll-unlocker: Dynamically unlocks camera zoom limits, useful for surveying large maps.
Q-Teleport: Quick teleportation to mouse cursor position (Press Ctrl+Q) for rapid map traversal.

scripts.script:
-- Serviços necessários
local Players = game:GetService("Players")
local UserInputService = game:GetService("UserInputService")
local RunService = game:GetService("RunService")

local LocalPlayer = Players.LocalPlayer
local Camera = workspace.CurrentCamera

-- Desativa o controle de toque padrão do Roblox para o script assumir
LocalPlayer.DevTouchMovementMode = Enum.DevTouchMovementMode.Scriptable

-- Criação da Interface (GUI)
local gui = Instance.new("ScreenGui")
gui.Name = "AnalogicoDeltaCustomizado"
gui.ResetOnSpawn = false

-- Tenta colocar no CoreGui (esconde do jogo) ou no PlayerGui
local success = pcall(function()
    gui.Parent = gethui and gethui() or game:GetService("CoreGui")
end)
if not success then
    gui.Parent = LocalPlayer:WaitForChild("PlayerGui")
end

-- 1. ZONA DE TOQUE E ANALÓGICO (Totalmente invisível e livre de visão)
local zonaToque = Instance.new("TextButton")
zonaToque.Size = UDim2.new(0, 240, 0, 240)
zonaToque.Position = UDim2.new(0, 10, 1, -230) -- Fixo na marcação branca
zonaToque.BackgroundTransparency = 1
zonaToque.Text = ""
zonaToque.AutoButtonColor = false
zonaToque.Active = true
zonaToque.Parent = gui

local fundoAnalogico = Instance.new("Frame")
fundoAnalogico.Size = UDim2.new(0, 140, 0, 140)
fundoAnalogico.Position = UDim2.new(0.5, -70, 0.5, -70)
fundoAnalogico.BackgroundTransparency = 1
fundoAnalogico.AnchorPoint = Vector2.new(0, 0)
fundoAnalogico.Visible = true
fundoAnalogico.Parent = zonaToque

-- 2. PINO DO ANALÓGICO (Botão Verde)
local pinoAnalogico = Instance.new("Frame")
pinoAnalogico.Size = UDim2.new(0, 50, 0, 50)
pinoAnalogico.BackgroundColor3 = Color3.new(0, 1, 0)
pinoAnalogico.BackgroundTransparency = 0.3
pinoAnalogico.AnchorPoint = Vector2.new(0.5, 0.5)
pinoAnalogico.Position = UDim2.new(0.5, 0, 0.5, 0)
pinoAnalogico.Parent = fundoAnalogico

local cantoPino = Instance.new("UICorner")
cantoPino.CornerRadius = UDim.new(1, 0)
cantoPino.Parent = pinoAnalogico

-- 3. BOTÃO DE PULO CUSTOMIZADO (Simples e funcional)
local botaoPuloCustom = Instance.new("ImageButton")
botaoPuloCustom.Name = "JumpButtonCustom"
botaoPuloCustom.Size = UDim2.new(0, 70, 0, 70)
botaoPuloCustom.Position = UDim2.new(1, -110, 1, -130)
botaoPuloCustom.BackgroundColor3 = Color3.fromRGB(45, 45, 45)
botaoPuloCustom.BackgroundTransparency = 0.3
botaoPuloCustom.Image = "rbxassetid://6074252252"
botaoPuloCustom.AutoButtonColor = true
botaoPuloCustom.Parent = gui

local cantoPulo = Instance.new("UICorner")
cantoPulo.CornerRadius = UDim.new(1, 0)
cantoPulo.Parent = botaoPuloCustom

local bordaPulo = Instance.new("UIStroke")
bordaPulo.Color = Color3.fromRGB(80, 80, 80)
bordaPulo.Thickness = 2
bordaPulo.Parent = botaoPuloCustom

-- Variável para controlar o pulo contínuo sem delay
local estaPulando = false

botaoPuloCustom.InputBegan:Connect(function(input)
    if input.UserInputType == Enum.UserInputType.Touch or input.UserInputType == Enum.UserInputType.MouseButton1 then
        estaPulando = true
    end
end)

local function soltarPulo(input)
    if input.UserInputType == Enum.UserInputType.Touch or input.UserInputType == Enum.UserInputType.MouseButton1 then
        estaPulando = false
    end
end

botaoPuloCustom.InputEnded:Connect(soltarPulo)
UserInputService.InputEnded:Connect(soltarPulo)

-- Variáveis de controle de movimento do analógico
local toqueAtual = nil
local vetorMovimento = Vector2.new(0, 0)
local raioMaximo = 35 -- Raio menor: anda devagar só pertinho do centro e atinge velocidade máxima rapidamente

-- Detecta quando o dedo/mouse pressiona a zona do analógico
zonaToque.InputBegan:Connect(function(input)
    if (input.UserInputType == Enum.UserInputType.Touch or input.UserInputType == Enum.UserInputType.MouseButton1) and toqueAtual == nil then
        toqueAtual = input
        vetorMovimento = Vector2.new(0, 0)
    end
end)

-- Detecta o dedo/mouse arrastando
UserInputService.InputChanged:Connect(function(input)
    if input == toqueAtual and (input.UserInputType == Enum.UserInputType.Touch or input.UserInputType == Enum.UserInputType.MouseMovement) then
        local absPos = fundoAnalogico.AbsolutePosition
        local absSize = fundoAnalogico.AbsoluteSize
        local centroX = absPos.X + (absSize.X / 2)
        local centroY = absPos.Y + (absSize.Y / 2)
        
        local delta = Vector2.new(input.Position.X, input.Position.Y) - Vector2.new(centroX, centroY)
        local distancia = delta.Magnitude
        
        -- O pino verde continua indo longe livremente (até 110 pixels)
        local raioVisualMax = 110
        local pinoDelta = delta
        if distancia > raioVisualMax then
            pinoDelta = delta.Unit * raioVisualMax
        end
        pinoAnalogico.Position = UDim2.new(0.5, pinoDelta.X, 0.5, pinoDelta.Y)
        
        -- Movimento limpo: Lento apenas bem perto do centro (zona morta de 4 pixels), rápido no resto
        if distancia > 4 then
            vetorMovimento = delta / raioMaximo
            if vetorMovimento.Magnitude > 1 then
                vetorMovimento = vetorMovimento.Unit
            end
        else
            vetorMovimento = Vector2.new(0, 0)
        end
    end
end)

-- Função para soltar o analógico
local function soltarAnalogico(input)

scripts.script:
local player = game.Players.LocalPlayer
local character = player.Character or player.CharacterAdded:Wait()
local humanoid = character:WaitForChild("Humanoid")

local gui = Instance.new("ScreenGui")
gui.Parent = player.PlayerGui

local frame = Instance.new("Frame")
frame.Size = UDim2.new(0, 180, 0, 120)
frame.Position = UDim2.new(0.5, -90, 0.5, -60)
frame.Parent = gui

local titulo = Instance.new("TextLabel")
titulo.Size = UDim2.new(1, 0, 0.3, 0)
titulo.Text = "Velocidad"
titulo.Parent = frame

local subir = Instance.new("TextButton")
subir.Size = UDim2.new(0.45, 0, 0.3, 0)
subir.Position = UDim2.new(0.05, 0, 0.5, 0)
subir.Text = "+"
subir.Parent = frame

local bajar = Instance.new("TextButton")
bajar.Size = UDim2.new(0.45, 0, 0.3, 0)
bajar.Position = UDim2.new(0.5, 0, 0.5, 0)
bajar.Text = "-"
bajar.Parent = frame

local velocidad = 16

subir.MouseButton1Click:Connect(function()
	velocidad = math.min(100, velocidad + 5)
	humanoid.WalkSpeed = velocidad
end)

bajar.MouseButton1Click:Connect(function()
	velocidad = math.max(0, velocidad - 5)
	humanoid.WalkSpeed = velocidad
end)
